description: Review items 2.1 (Study Dashboard 'Hoje'), 2.2 (progress visuals), 2.3 (visible gamification), 2.7 (Pomodoro -> XP) in the frontend, plus the Playwright smoke test with screenshots. The dashboard replaces the content of the existing StudyPage 'plan' mode (toolbar label 'Hoje'; no navigation.ts change); progress visuals replace the existing 'progress' mode panel. No chart library exists in frontend/package.json, so charts are plain SVG/CSS. Depends on FEAT-003 (GET /api/study/dashboard, GET /api/study/stats, POST /api/study/pomodoro) and FEAT-004 (Pomodoro dock, undo, shortcuts, LanguagePage changes).
steps: frontend/src/types.ts: add StudyDashboardData {today; due:{flashcards; vocabulary; next_due_at?: string|null}; xp:{total_xp; daily_xp; daily_goal; goal_met; studied_today; streak; best_streak; pomodoros}; level:{level; name; xp_into_level; xp_for_next; next_threshold}; badges: StudyBadge[]} , StudyBadge {id; label; description; earned}, StudyStatsData {heatmap:{date; reviews; xp}[]; daily_reviews:{date; tutor; language}[]; retention:{rate: number|null; correct; total; window_days}; states: Record<'tutor'|'language'|'total', {new; learning; review; relearning}>; totals:{reviews; pomodoros; vocabulary; flashcards}} matching app/storage/study_stats.py exactly (read it first).

New frontend/src/hooks/useStudyStats.ts: `useStudyStats(setNotice)` -> {dashboard, stats, refresh, awardPomodoro}; refresh uses Promise.allSettled over /api/study/dashboard and /api/study/stats (set each only when fulfilled and ok); awardPomodoro(minutes) POSTs /api/study/pomodoro {minutes}, on ok notice 'Pomodoro concluído! +20 XP' and refresh, else notice 'Não foi possível registrar o Pomodoro.'; initial refresh in useEffect([]).

New frontend/src/components/study/StudyDashboard.tsx (props: dashboard, current stage title, dueCards count fallback, enem/assessment counts, onAction callbacks): eyebrow 'HOJE'; chips '{n} flashcards para revisar', '{n} palavras para revisar', 'Próximo cartão em N min' when next_due_at is in the future; streak '🔥 {streak} dias seguidos' (+ 'recorde {best}' small) with a CSS pop animation class applied when streak or goal_met changes from the previous render (useRef), daily goal bar '{daily}/{goal} XP' with role=progressbar and aria-valuenow, 'Meta do dia batida!' when goal_met; level line 'Nível {level} · {name}' with progress bar xp_into_level/xp_for_next and 'faltam {n} XP'; quick actions = the six existing buttons from the current 'plan' panel (keep their exact messages/handlers) plus 'Revisar vocabulário' (opens language mode on the vocab tab). Loading state 'Carregando painel…' when dashboard is null.

New frontend/src/components/study/StudyProgress.tsx (props: stats, dashboard): (1) heatmap: SVG 53 columns × 7 rows (weeks start Sunday) of 11px cells with 2px gap from stats.heatmap; color buckets by xp relative to daily_goal (0, <25%, <50%, <100%, >=100%) using cyan opacities; each rect has <title>{dd/mm/aaaa}: {reviews} revisões, {xp} XP</title>; month labels on top; legend 'Menos … Mais'. (2) 'Revisões nos últimos 30 dias': SVG stacked bars tutor (cyan) + language (green #abbc7a) with day labels every 5 days and a legend 'ENEM' / 'Idiomas'. (3) 'Retenção (30 dias)': big '{rate*100}%' or '—' with caption '{correct} de {total} revisões de cartões maduros'. (4) 'Estados dos cartões': stacked horizontal bar + legend Novos/Aprendendo/Revisão/Reaprendendo with counts (total, and per deck small text). (5) 'Conquistas': badge grid, earned highlighted, locked dimmed with description as title. Keep the existing three stat chips at the top. Empty/zero data renders without errors.

frontend/src/pages/StudyPage.tsx: call useStudyStats(props.setNotice) inside StudyPage; activeMode 'plan' renders StudyDashboard inside the existing .study-overlay-panel.study-today wrapper; activeMode 'progress' renders StudyProgress inside a wider panel class 'study-overlay-panel study-progress-panel'. Refresh stats after: props.reviewCard and props.undoReview resolve (wrap them), language actions (pass a languageProps override object spreading props.languageProps and wrapping reviewVocab, undoVocabReview, deleteVocabulary, endConversation, startPronunciation-results via a `onStudyActivity` callback prop added to LanguagePage, called after its POSTs succeed) and Pomodoro: the dock's PomodoroTimer onComplete((phase, minutes) => phase === 'work' ? stats.awardPomodoro(minutes) : props.setNotice('Pausa concluída! Bora voltar ao foco.')). Add `languageTab` state: 'Revisar vocabulário' sets it to 'vocab' and activeMode to 'language'; LanguagePage gets optional `initialTab` prop used as the initial activeTab (render with key={languageTab} so it applies).

frontend/src/styles.css: styles for .study-progress-panel (width:min(760px, calc(100% - 24px)); max-height:calc(100% - 24px)), heatmap/bar/state-bar/legend/badge classes, dashboard XP/level bars, streak pop @keyframes (respect prefers-reduced-motion: no animation). Reuse existing palette.

New frontend/tests/study.smoke.cjs following frontend/tests/workspace.smoke.cjs (require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE || 'playwright'), broken-text.cjs assertSourceHasNoBrokenText on the new/changed source files and assertPageHasNoBrokenText, PANEL_TEST_URL, PANEL_TEST_OUTPUT screenshots dir, PASS logs) and frontend/tests/today.smoke.cjs (page.route('**/api/**') stateful fake, routeWebSocket for '**/ws/chat', addInitScript localStorage 'jarvis-active-screen'='Estudos'). Fake state: 2 due flashcards, 2 due vocab words, dashboard with streak 3 / daily 30 / goal 100 / level 2, stats with non-zero heatmap/daily_reviews/retention 0.85/states, language dashboard with stats.total_vocab 12, pronunciation_sessions 4, conversation_sessions 2, shadowing_sessions 1. Flow: (1) dashboard 'Hoje' visible with '2 flashcards para revisar', streak 3, 'Nível 2' -> screenshot study-dashboard.png; (2) click 'Revisar agora', press Space then '3' -> assert POST /api/tutor/flashcards/review body {card_id, grade: 2} and the second card is shown (no skipping) -> screenshot study-review-keyboard.png; (3) press 'z' -> assert POST /api/tutor/flashcards/undo and the first card is shown again -> screenshot study-undo.png; (4) toolbar 'Progresso' -> heatmap has 371 rects, '85%' retention text, state legend 'Revisão' -> screenshot study-progress.png; (5) toolbar 'Idiomas' -> tab 'Progresso' shows 12, 4, 2 (non-zero) -> screenshot language-progress.png; (6) tab 'Vocabulário' -> 'Excluir' on a word opens the ConfirmDialog (role alertdialog), confirm -> assert POST /api/language/vocabulary/{id}/delete; (7) Pomodoro: page.clock.install() before goto, click 'Iniciar' in the dock, page.clock.fastForward('25:01') -> assert POST /api/study/pomodoro {minutes: 25} exactly once and the notice text. Exit non-zero on any failure.

DEVIATIONS/DECISIONS: (1) Heatmap aligns weeks to Sunday, so 371 days take 53 or 54 columns depending on today's weekday (always 371 rects). (2) Language activity refresh: LanguagePage gets onStudyActivity, called from an effect whenever useLanguage delivers a new dashboard object. Every successful language POST (review, undo, delete, add, conversation, pronunciation, shadowing) ends in refreshLanguage, so one hook covers all of them, and useLanguage did not have to change. Tutor reviewCard/undoReview are wrapped in StudyPage (refresh after they resolve). (3) awardPomodoro: <5 min focus blocks show 'Pomodoro concluído! Blocos com menos de 5 min não valem XP.' without POSTing; >90 min (after +5 extensions) are sent as 90. Breaks show 'Pausa concluída! Bora voltar ao foco.'. (4) The 'Hoje' panel always shows the 7 quick actions; only the XP/streak/level block shows 'Carregando painel…' while dashboard is null. Chips also keep 'questões salvas' and 'simulados'. (5) Toolbar 'Idiomas' resets languageTab to 'home'; 'Revisar vocabulário' opens it on 'vocab' (LanguagePage key={languageTab}, initialTab prop; LangTab type now exported). (6) Streak text is singular for 1 ('1 dia seguido').
